claims.claim: AIOS_BRAIN_WORK_CONTEXT v1 composes a detached Brain Sync observation and a separately validated structured current_request, preserves canonical roadmap, task, Unified State, action, authority, and blocker facts, enforces the 16384-byte UTF-8 input bound, and carries a deterministic request-scoped invalidation fingerprint.

Flow Resolution v1 derives semantic obligations only from the three specified Unified State actions, gives an explicit structured side-flow precedence without clearing a pending obligation or blocker, selects TASK_AUTHORING for an unauthored unique NEXT, and otherwise returns NONE.

The repository-owned registry contains exactly six validated Flow Cards with bounded context, authority, canonical contract references, handoff, return, and invalidation metadata; its loader rejects missing, duplicate, unknown, malformed, and authority-inconsistent definitions.

The three new surfaces only read and classify observations. They contain no persistence, dispatch, lifecycle reduction, provider protocol, or frozen Kernel change, and report all mutation and invocation flags as false.

Offline regression cases were added for operational and semantic states, unauthored NEXT, explicit side-flows, blocked diagnostics, obligation preservation, request bounds, fingerprint changes, invalid Flow Cards, and read-only call paths. Existing Brain Sync files were not changed.
